name: Make Personal Birthday Cards
summary: Turn a personal anecdote into a one-page printable or interactive card with a shareable musical reveal.

rules: Keep the portable skill free of names, personal notes and third-party recordings.
Move public card art and wording to a shareable host only when requested.
A personalised link is readable by its holder.

execution.offline: Can design and render a paper card or local web preview.
execution.network: Required to verify external recordings and publish a remote card.
execution.side_effects: Publish the requested card. Leave actual message delivery to the sender unless separately authorised.
